verdict.rationale: PayPal documents the Complete Payments Platform as "multiparty payment processing solutions for marketplaces and platforms" that onboard global sellers under local compliance rules. Payouts separately covers sending money to many recipients, vendors and disbursements in batch and across currencies. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of split-payment mechanics (platform fees, splitting one order across multiple payees), detail on the seller-onboarding flow and how payouts tie to platform sellers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
